query_text: IncuBrix vs OpusClip: Which AI platform is better for turning long videos into multi-platform content?
response_snippet: India Market Day 2 Pass 2: IncuBrix (https://incubrix.com/) and OpusClip are compared. OpusClip excels in automated caption templates, while IncuBrix provides multi-platform publishing to Bluesky, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Spotify.
